integrity: Both integral eigensubgroup presentations were recomputed with exact integer and local-prime matrix operations, independently for four rooted Laplacians. No floating point or external proof certification.
scientific_limitations: The canonical 56-vertex weighted multigraph is defined for every complex degree-two del Pezzo surface. The Neron group interpretation is conditional on the full exceptional divisor being nodal and on an equivariant regular split semistable unit-thickness smoothing; no universal realization is asserted. Priority is provisional; no independent mathematical audit has taken place.
title: Geiser-fixed and Geiser-anti-fixed groups of the full del Pezzo exceptional boundary
